title: Inside Help TDS: Hotejka, Cloudflare Pages and Predictive Detection
content: Since April 2017, a Russian-language affiliate program called Hotejka, believed to be a rebrand of ROI777, has operated the Help Traffic Distribution System (TDS), delivering tech support scams to victims. title: BREAK THE SILENCE: Tracking Silent Lynx Through Exposed Infrastructure

title: AI-Powered Espionage Campaign Targets Government Linux Infrastructure

title: KGB RAT: A Fully Undetectable Windows Trojan Built to Spy, Steal, and Terrorize
content: KGB RAT is a Windows Remote Access Trojan actively promoted on underground forums since late 2025, marketed deceptively as a legitimate administration tool.
